summary: JBG SMITH Properties filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement for its operating partnership. The new $690.0 million senior unsecured revolving credit facility matures August 27, 2030, replacing the existing $750.0 million facility due 2027. It includes an option to increase commitments or add term loans up to $560.0 million. As of August 27, 2026, $230.0 million was drawn. Interest is SOFR or base rate plus spreads based on indebtedness ratios. This is routine financing, not a special situation.
